column1: # A synthetic placement of 10 pods on 3 nodes over 40 minutes. No row here is from the trace.
# One line is a run of observations of one subject, asserted by the producer
# alibaba/placement in the second layer with the event time basis "producer event":
#   kind   name   on   start_s   count   step_s   ttl_s   through_s   payload
# kind is pod, node or edge (a pod on a node: name is the pod, on is the node).
# start_s is the first event time in seconds from the epoch; count observations follow,
# step_s apart, each with a TTL of ttl_s. through_s, if not "-", is the Through of the
# last observation of the line. payload is text, or "-" for none. The records of all
# lines are ordered by event time, then by line, and numbered from 1 in steps of 3, so
# that a renumbering of them changes the data.
# The three nodes. n1 is sampled every 30 seconds: 80 observations, more than the 64
# a prefix holds before a checkpoint is due, on an entity prefix.
# Pods 1 to 4 on n1, sampled every minute for the whole time. n1's reverse edge prefix
# holds four pods' edges: 160 records, on an edge prefix.
# Pod 5 on n2 with a gap of 120 seconds in its samples, within the TTL of 180.
# Pod 6 on n2 with a gap of 300 seconds, beyond the TTL.
# Pod 7 on n2 as one record that stands for a run: it was observed until second 2340.
# Pods 8 to 10 on n3, which come and go.
